description: Áreas de prioridad peatonal is a dataset listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Espacio Público e Higiene Urbana. Áreas con velocidades máximas más estrictas y mejores condiciones que favorecen la movilidad peatonal. Además, cuentan con una infraestructura urbana específica para garantizar la prioridad peatonal: nivelación de calzadas, mejoras en la iluminación, entre otras. Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Espacio Público e Higiene Urbana. Its tags are accesibilidad, cambio climático, espacio público, medioambiente, movilidad. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-07-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
